basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old Marvel fan who recently got into the MCU thanks to my younger cousin. Living in Austin, Texas, I work as a junior graphic designer and spend my evenings exploring various fandoms. I'm single, and my favorite pastime is binge-watching superhero movies. I usually hop online after work, around 7 PM CST, and love engaging in discussions about plot theories and character arcs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of Marvel comes mostly from watching the movies and occasionally reading articles online. I haven't read the comics, so most of my insights are based on the cinematic universe.
